patch_description: Replace the 8 independent RY parameters with a parity-shared pair (ry_even, ry_odd), reducing per-block single-qubit params from 8 to 2. Split the previously fully-shared ZZ ring into alternating "zz_even" (0-1,2-3,4-5,6-7) and "zz_odd" (1-2,3-4,5-6,7-0) parameters to enrich entanglement expressivity at minimal parameter cost (+1 param). Keep the shared RZ phase layer. This mirrors the highest-scoring prior design's parameter-sharing philosophy (shared RY + shared entangler + shared RZ) while adding the even/odd ZZ split recommendation, aiming to cut N_PARAMS substantially (from 62 to ~26) while preserving or improving accuracy and convergence speed, directly targeting the parameter-economy reward.
